narrative.overview: Mezzanine is a dark room with one light source: the film you are looking at. A near-black graphite ground carries the interface; the focused title throws its own colour across it. Chrome has no hue of its own; the single exception is one lilac, spent on the primary action and the current selection. The system is quiet and precise, and nothing floats in the middle of the window: text and messages sit on a 40 pt gutter, left-aligned, below the toolbar.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite room, never pure black; the room light follows focus.
One accent (lilac), two jobs: primary action, current selection.
Focus is lift, shadow, lilac caption, room light and a play disc. No rings.
Left-aligned on a 40 pt gutter; one ruled caption of facts under each title.
Solid surfaces over art; glass only on toolbar, sidebar and player controls.
Every key has a menu item; every hit target is the whole control.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome carries no hue. Colour comes from artwork and the room light; the only exception is lilac.

rules.name: The One Lilac Rule
rules.body: Lilac is for the primary action and the current selection. Not for links, badges, toggles or decoration.

rules.name: The Steady Floor Rule
rules.body: The room light fades to graphite toward the bottom; text and posters never sit on saturated colour.

rules.name: The Title Card Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is used at weight 800, in capitals, for a title with no logo, and nowhere else in the UI.

rules.name: The Numbers Rule
rules.body: Captions state facts in tabular figures, separated by " · ". No adjectives.

rules.name: The Glass Is Chrome Rule
rules.body: Liquid Glass appears only on toolbar, sidebar and player controls. Never on posters, captions, panels or messages.

rules.name: The No Bleed Rule
rules.body: No translucent panels that let content show through behind text.

dos: Do keep chrome hueless; let artwork and the room light supply colour.
Do use lilac (#A08CFF) only for the primary action and the current selection.
Do show focus as lift, shadow, lilac caption, room light and play disc.
Do make the whole button the hit target (capsule, disc, card).
Do use solid raised surfaces for secondary controls and anything over art.
Do left-align messages and text on the 40 pt gutter, clear of the toolbar.
Do write captions as facts in tabular figures joined by " · ", with a hairline above.
Do crossfade light at 0.45 s, move objects with spring 0.38 and no bounce, and fall back to crossfade under Reduce Motion.
Do give every shortcut a menu item.
donts: Don't put Liquid Glass on content; toolbar, sidebar and player controls only.
Don't draw focus rings or use system focus effects on content.
Don't use translucent panels with content bleeding through behind text.
Don't centre or float content in the window; no centred empty or loading states.
Don't use the pointing-hand cursor on cards.
Don't scroll on hover; only keyboard moves scroll.
Don't add a second accent, a coloured badge, or tint chrome with a film's colour.
Don't use Big Shoulders for anything but a logo-less title card.
